text:
Raj (CEO): quick mic drop from the all-hands: several customers asked for exact launch windows for the Console batching controls, API billing tiers, and Optimize suggestion engine. can we publish something short and actionable today?

Amelia (Product): agreed. propose we give a two-week cadence: (1) internal canaries, (2) limited partner beta, (3) public GA. need owners for each stage per feature.

Devon (Eng): rough engineering timeline: batching controls - internal canary week of 2024-06-24, partner beta 2024-07-08, GA 2024-07-22. API tiers - beta by 2024-07-01, GA mid-August. Optimize suggestions - alpha read-only 2024-06-30, write-mode early September. all rough, subject to certify and legal signoff.

Amelia (Product): can we be clearer about what GA means? ops + legal have to sign SLAs for Dedicated customers.

Priya (Legal): yes. for billing tiers we need contract language for rate changes and data handling. legal will review tiering terms by July 10 if we get the proposal by July 1.

Oscar (Sales): sales ask: partners need a migration playbook and an easy opt-out. also a suggested customer-facing FAQ simple enough for an AE to read on a call.

Lina (Marketing): i'll prep a short FAQ + one-slide TL;DR for AEs if we get dates. prefer "internal canary late June; partner beta early July; GA late July" wording.

Devon (Eng): noted on opt-out. batching UI will include a global switch per-tenant + a per-route override. sample API we intend to expose for opt-out:

```
PUT /v1/tenant/config
{ "features": { "smart_batching": "disabled" } }
```

This will be permissioned.

Amelia (Product): product commitments (short): publish timeline doc (owner: Amelia & Kai), migration playbook (owner: Oscar & Kai), legal terms draft (owner: Priya). Can owners confirm?

Oscar (Sales): I can take migration playbook + partner checklist. will pull sample customers and draft migration Q&A by July 3.

Priya (Legal): taking the legal terms draft. will sync with finance for pricing guardrails. target review ready July 10.

Devon (Eng): engineering action items: add per-tenant opt-out endpoint, shipping telemetry for batching effectiveness (p50/p95 token latency + batching ratio), and add a flag for read-only Optimize suggestions. landing PRs by June 21 for canary.

Raj (CEO): small ask for comms: include rollback windows and an explicit instruction that customers on Dedicated+ get a 14-day notice before any quota changes. keeps trust high.

Amelia (Product): we'll include that. also adding a small note: default behavior for existing customers will be "no change" until they opt in to tiering. makes migration lower risk.

Lina (Marketing): timeline phrasing suggestion: "Late-June internal canary; early-July partner beta; late-July public rollout (subject to certification & SLA signoff)." want to lock that sentence now?

Devon (Eng): technically yes for batching UI. API tiers and Optimize have slightly different dates but we can present a combined calendar with per-feature footnotes.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: runtime v1.9.3 -> us-west cluster on 2024-06-24T02:00:00Z (6 nodes).

Amelia (Product): ok final actions: (1) publish single-page timeline + feature footnotes (owner: Amelia) by end of day today, (2) Migration playbook draft (owner: Oscar) by July 3, (3) Legal terms for tiers (owner: Priya) by July 10, (4) Engineering canary PRs (owner: Devon) by June 21.

Raj (CEO): thanks all. please post the timeline doc in #all-hands and #customer-comm. i'll co-sign the customer note for enterprise accounts.

Amelia (Product): will do. pinning this thread and will drop the doc link here when live. :spiral_calendar_pad:
